ownership_reason: Only the gold decides which name a configuration has for the property that includes other properties files (the default name while none has been set, none for an empty name, else the name set); hops 1-4 hand the two names on unchanged. The convention is pinned outside the gold: ExtendedProperties.setInclude documents 'empty converted to null' (and stores the empty string for null), and ExtendedProperties.load treats a null include name as no inclusion, ignores empty values and never reads an empty key, so the empty string is never the name of a property that includes other files. With the variant gold (the name set if not null, else the default name) the trigger's null for an empty name can only come out of the gold if both names it is given are null, and every hop and the gold document the default name as not null, so no hop can produce it while every method on the path is used as documented; an early answer or a rewrite of the result at a hop re-implements the gold's decision (recorded bypasses). Passing tests drive the chain on the default path through load().
